_comment: RP plugin guidance-nudge rows. Schema and gate semantics: see plugins/session/hooks/nudges/rules.json. Rows here are merged by nudge-engine.sh alongside every other plugin's rules.json and the ~/.asha/nudges.json user layer (later wins by id). A relative inject_file resolves against THIS plugin's hooks/nudges/ directory.

rules.match_regex: \bescap(e|es|ed|ing)\b|\bget(ting)? out\b|\bway out\b|\bleav(e|ing) the\b|\b(the|an|no|any) (exit|entrance)\b|\bentry point\b|\bbreak in\b|\bsever(s|ed|ing)?\b|\bclose off\b|\bcut off\b|\bpermanent(ly)?\b|\bforever\b|\birreversib|\bundone\b|\bresurrect|\breviv(e|es|ed|ing|al)\b|\braise the dead\b|\bbring(ing)? [^.!?]{0,40}\bback\b|\bbrought [^.!?]{0,40}\bback\b|never come(s)? back|come back from|\bbanish|\bdispel|\bwhat price\b|\ba price\b|what it costs|what does it cost|at what cost|\bbargain|\bpact(s)?\b|\bpay(ing|s)?[^.!?]{0,16}\btoll\b|\b(world|time|loop|day) reset\b|reset the (world|loop|day|timeline)|\bdoom(ed)?\b
rules._comment: Fires when a turn's text touches a class of thing settings typically price: exits and entrances, permanence and reversal, resurrection, banishment, bargains. Diagnosed 2026-07-26 (Darkest House): a GM adjudicated how a character leaves the house and invented a costless exit without ever opening the Source Rules Reference, which lists six escape methods, closed, each priced. That diagnosis is provenance only — the regex is deliberately setting-agnostic and MUST stay that way: proper nouns from one campaign (a specific NPC, door, or location) in a shipped rule fire on that campaign's vocabulary and stay silent in every other project, which is the opposite of the intent. Projects add their own trigger vocabulary by redefining this row in ~/.asha/nudges.json (merged by id, user wins). Regex discipline (2026-08-04 adversarial review): every short token is \b-bounded ('pact' fired on 'impact', 'exit' on 'she exits the carriage', 'toll' on 'the bell tolls'); high-frequency phrases are narrowed to their stake senses ('come back' -> 'never come back'/'come back from'; bare 'reset' -> world/loop/day resets; bare 'the price' -> 'what price'/'a price'); match_ci is REQUIRED because the alternations are lowercase and turns start with capitals — without it 'Escape the house?' never fires. A false fire is not free: it stamps the shared 1h cooldown and suppresses the next REAL stake, so precision here is the rule's actual budget. Payload is a POINTER plus a protocol duty, not injected content — the register stays in the project, and content injection would cost context on every fire. Marker-gated so it is inert outside RP; 1h cooldown so a stake-heavy scene does not nag. Kill switch: Work/markers/nudge-rp-priced-stakes-off (generic) or rp-priced-stakes-off (marker_off).
